## Intended use and limits

Detects the VigilOne v1 classes (person, bicycle, motorcycle, car, bus, truck) in sampled CCTV frames to drive
tripwire, loitering and object rules. Other COCO classes are dropped before tracking. Not for identifying
people. COCO-trained: accuracy on Indian site conditions (night IR, rain, low mounting angles, crowded
two-wheeler traffic) is unknown until measured.
